params.name: vpAreaName
params.description: 4D View Pro area form object name

params.name: row
params.description: Row index (counting begins at 0) of the first row of the range

params.name: rowCount
params.description: Total number of rows of the range (default 1); must be greater than 0

overloads.semanticRole: The VP Row command returns a new range object referencing a specific row or rows.

constraints: An error is returned if vpAreaName does not designate an existing 4D View Pro area.
rowCount must be greater than 0; if omitted, it defaults to 1.
